name: Flashback Weekend
blurb: A Chicago-area horror-film convention held each year at the Hyatt Regency O'Hare in Rosemont, Illinois.
notes: Homepage still shows the just-finished 2026 edition ('Flashback Weekend Chicago Horror Con July 31-August 2, 2026 Hyatt Regency O'Hare Chicago Rosemont, IL') and says 'THANK YOU FOR ATTENDING FLASHBACK WEEKEND 2026. STAY TUNED FOR ANNOUNCEMENTS FOR ... 2027!' -- no 2027 dates are announced yet, confirmed by a web search turning up nothing newer than the 2026 dates. Recorded as 'last' rather than an edition since it ended before the 2026-10-05 research window.
